Vite + React 19 Static SPA (no backend)
nodes.rationale: App is a bundle of standalone Hunt: Showdown themed mini-games with no backend and no API calls; all state is local, some persisted in localStorage.

nodes.label: HashRouter Routing Decision
nodes.rationale: HashRouter is used instead of BrowserRouter because the app ships as static files behind nginx with no rewrite rules, so deep-link paths would 404. Unknown paths redirect to /.

nodes.label: LuckyShot Game (revolver cylinder)
nodes.rationale: Cylinder spun with framer-motion; 6 bullet slots at fixed rotation STOPS, 3 shots max; result modal fires from onAnimationComplete rather than a timer so the modal is tied to the real animation end.

nodes.label: TarotCards Game
nodes.rationale: Shuffles 12 cards and draws 3; each card carries result: boolean plus flavor text, so win/lose is data on the card rather than computed logic.

nodes.label: XMas Advent Calendar Game
nodes.rationale: 24-day advent calendar; opened days persisted via useMapLocalStorage so progress survives reloads without a backend.

nodes.label: Memory Pair-Matching Game
nodes.rationale: easy/normal/hard modes map to 8/10/12 pairs; hard mode adds a 4-minute countdown driven by requestAnimationFrame + luxon (rAF instead of setInterval for smooth drift-free timing); selected mode persisted in localStorage.

nodes.label: Path Aliases @root and @assets
nodes.rationale: @root/* -> src/*, @assets/* -> assets/*. Declared in BOTH vite.config.mts and tsconfig.json; the duplication must be kept in sync or the type-check and the bundler disagree.

nodes.label: Assets Are Imported, Not URL-Referenced
nodes.rationale: assets/ is a Vite-processed source dir, not a static dir (copyPublicDir: false, outDir: public). public/ is build output and gitignored, so URL references would break. Every new asset extension needs an ambient module declaration in src/Types/assets.d.ts.

nodes.label: SVG Import Suffix Selects Loader
nodes.rationale: ?react yields a React component via vite-plugin-svgr with svgo prefixIds randomizing ids so multiple inlined SVGs cannot collide; ?url yields a URL for .

nodes.label: Audio Playback via Promise-Returning play(ref)
nodes.rationale: One <audio ref> per sound rendered at the bottom of each game component; src/Utils/Player.ts play(ref) returns a Promise resolving on 'ended' so games can sequence gameplay on sound completion (LuckyShot starts the spin after the start sound ends).

nodes.label: Imperative Modal Injection (renderInjection)
nodes.rationale: src/Utils/renderInjection.ts appends a div, mounts a separate React root, and returns a teardown function, so modals live outside the component tree and need no parent state; the id argument guards against duplicate mounts.

nodes.label: Component/Modal Shared Shell
nodes.rationale: Shared modal shell handling Escape and shadow close, using forwardRef to expose show/hide imperatively.

nodes.label: Flip Cards Expose Imperative Refs
nodes.rationale: Memory/Card and TarotCards/Card use forwardRef + useImperativeHandle exposing open()/close(); the parent keeps cardRefs.current[] and drives animation directly instead of threading per-card state down.

nodes.label: Per-Component SCSS + BEM-ish + 62.5% rem base
nodes.rationale: One index.scss per component imported by that component; BEM-ish names (memory__table--hard) composed with clsx; global reset in src/main.scss sets html font-size: 62.5% so 1rem = 10px.

nodes.label: tsc Strict Build as Only Verification Gate
nodes.norm_label: tsc strict build as only verification gate
nodes.rationale: No tests, linter, or formatter exist; npm run build (tsc with strict, noUnusedLocals, noUnusedParameters) is the sole gate, so unused imports or params fail the build.

nodes.label: Multi-Stage Docker Build Served by nginx:alpine
nodes.norm_label: multi-stage docker build served by nginx:alpine
nodes.rationale: Build stage runs npm install && npm run build; nginx:alpine serves /usr/share/nginx/html as plain static files with no rewrite rules, which is what forces HashRouter.

nodes.label: Dead Code from Vite Template
nodes.rationale: src/counter.ts and src/javascript.svg are unreferenced leftovers from the Vite starter template.

nodes.label: Knowledge Base Binding (crytek.games / lucky-shot)
nodes.rationale: SwarmVault project_id crytek.games and graphify_id lucky-shot; Related Projects table is generated from /var/www/knowledge-base/project-relations.json and must not be hand-edited.

nodes.label: Web Games PWA Icon and Manifest Set
nodes.norm_label: web games pwa icon and manifest set
nodes.rationale: Absolute-rooted favicon/apple-touch-icon/site.webmanifest hrefs plus the 'Web Games' title and apple-mobile-web-app-title; these live in the real static root, not the Vite-processed assets/ dir.
